artboards.title: Before — Assets and Loans as they stand

annotations.text:
Assets and Loans, combined into one register.
The page leads with what is owed and when; the things owned sit under it, one row each, with the loan that bought a thing folded onto its row.
Read left to right: today's two pages, then the console at 1440.

The old performance and depreciation modals, unpacked onto the row.
Worth against owed — the reading neither page could give — is the block that used to be three clicks inside a modal.

The phone is its own design, not the console reflowed:
cards, the figures readable without opening anything,
and the one thing to do at 44px on the card itself.

Empty, one row, and the case the old design buried: a thing worth less than is owed on it.
Also what this redesign removes, and what it deliberately leaves alone.
